_doc: TACKING (d10), Close Action 1997 combat chart (docs/combat_tables_1.jpeg). Maneuver type -> highest d10 roll (0-9) that succeeds at wind speed 1, 2, 3, 4: roll <= number succeeds, and a natural 0 always succeeds. DRMs (applied by MovementResolver): +/- SK mod, +2 per crew section not plotted to T (up to +6, errata 5.D.2a), +2 per rigging section lost, +1 in irons, +1 towing, +3 reversing tack, +3 rudder destroyed, -2 ship not at WF=L (errata 5.D.2b). No turning at wind speed 0 (5.D.1a).
